newsitem.title: USA: Group will still nominate 15 for Sallie Mae board.
newsitem.headline: Group will still nominate 15 for Sallie Mae board.

text.p: The Committee to Restore Value (CRV), group opposing the management of Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae), said Wednesday it still intends to nominate 15 people for the board of directors.
"Shareholders should be able to decide whether they want us and our business plan or David Vitale and his business plan," said Paul Carey, a spokesman for the CRV in a telephone interview.
Earlier Wednesday, Sallie Mae said David Vitale, a director for the last 20 years, is being proposed as a nominee for non-executive chairman of the board.
Vitale is vice chairman of First Chicago NBD Corp.
The CRV, in saying it would proceed with plans to nominate 15 people to the board, rejected the Sallie Mae management's proposal for a board consisting of both management and CRV directors.
Sallie Mae said it will nominate 10 candidates for a 15-member board and five seats will be held for nominees submitted by the CRV.
"We have no interest (in being a minority) on a board controlled by David Vitale and his banking friends," Carey said.
In a separate telephone interview Wednesday, Vitale said if the CRV does not propose candidates for the five board positions "we'll move ahead without them."
